name: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery
overview: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) replicates source servers to AWS staging resources and supports point-in-time recovery drills/failover.
examSignals: Pilot-light style server recovery with continuous block replication: AWS DRS
Backup-and-restore policies across AWS services: AWS Backup

compareWith.diff: DRS continuously replicates server disks for recovery/failover; AWS Backup stores scheduled recovery points for supported resources.
